title: The Daily Adventures of Mixerman
description: Mixerman is a Los Angeles recording engineer who in the summer of 2002, on nothing more than a hunch, began to chronicle the daily events of his Major Label recording session with a bidding-war band, an infamous producer, and a limitless budget. And he did it in real-time—each night posting his entries on the Internet, withholding only the true identities of those he writes about. As Gina Arnold from Metro Newspapers reported at the time: "Mixerman is supposed to be writing about recording techniques, but somehow, through that prism, he has hit upon a gripping story. In this podcast, you will hear an audio dramatization of the story, as narrated by Mixerman, complete with music, foley, sound fx, and character performances by some of the most famous engineers and producers in the music business.

episodes.title: The Supreme Negotiators
episodes.notes:
The Daily Adventures of Mixerman

A recording engineer known only as "Mixerman" discusses his plan to surreptitiously post an online diary about his upcoming LA recording session with a Major Label bidding war band and an infamous producer. Madness abounds.

This story was read by well over 150,000  music professionals at the time of its posting 20 years ago. It was published as a hard cover book by Hal Leonard in 2008. Then made an audiobook in 2012 complete with music, leitmotifs, sound fx, foley, with an ensemble cast of the most famous producers and engineers on earth performing the character dialogue. And now I present to you the final audio version, with even more music, and more story enhancing sound. Next stop the television studio.

Please note: In the first chapter, Mixerman can be heard typing as he writes. Worry not. This only occurs in this one particular episode. it's a wild ride. Just buckle up and enjoy it. 

Enjoy!
